Update the README

## Goal

Make the README describe your team's app, so a new teammate could get it running from a clean clone.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The README has your app name and a one-paragraph description.
- [ ] It lists team members by GitHub username, with their roles.
- [ ] It has setup steps: `pnpm install`, the `.env` variables you need, and `pnpm start`.
- [ ] It has your branch and PR rules, and your commit message style.
- [ ] The update is merged into `develop` through a reviewed pull request.

## Where to look

Canvas: [Team] GitHub Repository & Project Board Setup.
